The '''Imperial Embassy''' was the diplomatic mission of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to the [[Human-Qieg Guild]], and was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]] in [[Shulell City]]. It was staffed by four [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] who had displeased their superiors and earned a punishment posting.<ref name="LB" />
